scope: Bounded investigation of whether the existing partial-DWG-read CLI contract can be exercised for AC1012 and AC1014 inputs without weakening source-version, bounded-frame, object, or reference checks.

completedInvestigation.evidence: tests/dwg_local_roundtrip_tests.cpp --generate-cli-partial-read-source accepts AC1015, AC1018, AC1021, AC1024, AC1027, and AC1032 only. It cannot create an AC1012/AC1014 source for this contract.
libdxfrw dwgRW::write rejects versions below AC1015 with DRW::BAD_VERSION. Its DWG writer cannot produce an AC1012/AC1014 test source.
The CLI default target maps AC1012 to AC1014 and AC1014 to AC1014. A target version mapping alone does not make the source eligible for partial publication.

A minimal hand-authored DXF was rejected as too small. A larger LibreDWG-generated R14 file and a LibreDWG round trip of a local R14 input did not pass libdxfrw's reader/handle checks, so neither is an eligible recovery witness. All generated files remained in scratch.

disposition.completed: The local generator/version-gate audit and bounded legacy-input screen are complete and removed from the active queue.
disposition.stillOpen: The AC1012/AC1014 partial-read/output contract remains open. Current observations do not establish a safely publishable partial result or prove later-record recovery for these revisions.
disposition.resumeWhen: A hash-bound AC1012/AC1014 source reaches the output gate with only eligible recoverable entity failures and closed object/reference dependencies, or a new independently valid local source-generation path becomes available.
disposition.safety: Do not weaken exact-version serialization, bounded-frame disposition, or object/reference closure gates. Do not commit downloaded or third-party test drawings.

limitations: These local inputs are not repository fixtures and are not being promoted as support evidence.
This investigation does not qualify AC1012/AC1014 parser correctness, output compatibility, native semantics, or cross-platform behavior.
Strict destination preservation and corrected same-writer retry remain required for any future eligible recovery case.
nextAction: Continue the locally ready P6-G public-writer route audit using the refreshed mention index; resume this row only when the stated eligible-source condition is met.
